title: content/offices.yaml
description: The offices of the state. Field names follow the Office type in sim/Statecraft.Sim/Content.cs; a test keeps them equal.

id.description: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter. Unique.

title.description: The official English title, as the player sees it.

historical_only.description: Historical record only: no Cabinet seat, no player appointment, no gameplay.

several_holders.description: Several people may hold it on the same day (Minister without Portfolio, a second deputy minister). Such an office cannot appear in event text or own policies or effects, and the player cannot appoint to it.

from.description: Day the office was established (inclusive). Leave out if it exists from the start.

until.description: Day the office was abolished (exclusive). Leave out while it still exists.
